bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-Gap) between male and female demographic groups on classification tasks, specifically profession prediction (using the BiasBios dataset) and hate speech recognition.
Measuring the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-Gap) between white and non-white demographic groups on a hate speech recognition task (using the Multilingual Twitter Hate Speech corpus).
Measuring the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-Gap) between young and old demographic groups on a hate speech recognition task.
Measuring the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-Gap) between US and non-US demographic groups on a hate speech recognition task.
Measuring the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-Gap) between high-reputation and low-reputation users on a post helpfulness prediction task (using the Multilingual Stack Exchange Fairness dataset).
